_purpose: Per-branch OpEx allocation rules (Rule N1, admin-editable). Used by utils.branch_pbt_allocator.compute_pbt_by_branch to distribute bank.total_opex_kes_b across branches.

_available_rules.fte_weighted: Allocate by branch FTE share (default per Q3 v10.367 decision). Falls back to 'accounts per branch' proxy if FTE data unavailable.
_available_rules.revenue_weighted: Allocate by branch operating-income share. Each branch's share of total OpEx = its share of total income.
_available_rules.equal: Split equally across all branches with any activity. Useful for sanity-check / fallback.
_available_rules.hybrid: 50% FTE-weighted + 50% revenue-weighted. Weights configurable above (hybrid_fte_weight + hybrid_revenue_weight must sum to 1.0).

_fte_source_chain: 2. data/branch_fte.json if it exists (admin can populate)
3. Proxy: accounts per branch (degraded, flagged in notes)
4. Equal: if all branches have 0 accounts (terminal fallback)
